summary: Windows message pump with optional pacing sleep. Peeks the message queue; if a message is present, enters a GetMessageA/TranslateMessage/DispatchMessageA loop and returns -1 when GetMessageA returns 0 (WM_QUIT). If no message is pending, returns 0 after sleeping for an InputClamp-derived duration unless the sleep is suppressed by byte_7CE2E4.

operations.description: PeekMessageA to test whether a message is pending without removing it.
Branch on PeekMessageA result: message present enters the dispatch loop, otherwise the no-message sleep path is taken.
Loop while GetMessageA returns nonzero (message retrieved and not WM_QUIT).
DispatchMessageA to route the message to its window procedure.
Return -1 when GetMessageA returns 0 (WM_QUIT received), aborting the pump.
On the no-message path, skip sleeping when byte_7CE2E4 is nonzero (sleep suppressed).
Compute the sleep duration from byte_7CE498 via InputClamp.
Sleep only when InputClamp returns a non-negative duration.
Call Sleep with the computed duration when no message is pending and sleep is not suppressed.

unresolved: byte_7CE2E4 sleep-suppression flag semantics are DERIVED from the skeleton analysis, not independently confirmed.
